title: tc-budget-burn
description:
Budget burn: each item's spend against its budget, with a pace marker and words for ahead, on or behind pace, its
people and team, totals in the header and a sort by burn or budget.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

period.description: How far through the period we are, from 0 to 1; unset hides the pace marker and words

tolerance.description: How far, as a share of the budget, spend may sit from the pace before it's ahead or behind

sort.description: "budget" puts the biggest budgets first, "burn" the highest burn. Changed by the user unless a tc-sort-change listener calls preventDefault()

currency.description: The budget's currency, an ISO 4217 code

peopleUnit.description: The unit people are counted in: "FTE", "people"

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

owner.description: Who leads it, shown under the name

committed.description: Under contract but not yet spent, in `currency`; adds to the header's committed total

team.description: The team's names; each shows as initials

priority.description: A short priority mark, e.g. "1" or "P1"
